entries.title: LandPortal via bounded Hermes specialists
entries.summary: Exact-subject facts, visible comps, and verified parcel visuals are returned as isolated handbacks and admitted only by LandOS.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Verify exact property identity and capture time on every assignment.

entries.title: Official county assessor and GIS
entries.summary: County-specific official records are preferred for parcel identity, assessment, deeds, and local GIS layers.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Validate the official domain and source date per retrieval.

entries.title: HomeHarvest comparable provider
entries.summary: Structured land-comparable candidate provider behind the existing provider registry and identity checks.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Record provider retrieval time and listing or sale date.

entries.title: Apify comparable adapters
entries.summary: Provider adapter for supported listing sources; results remain candidates until deterministic reconciliation.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Record source URL, retrieval time, and provider outcome.

entries.title: Google visual evidence
entries.summary: Parcel visual capture is admitted only with verified property association and required artifact metadata.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Preserve capture time, source, framing, and eligibility decision.

entries.title: Browser comparable fallbacks
entries.summary: Redfin, Zillow, Realtor, and other browser flows report results, no-result, blocked, timed-out, unavailable, or skipped independently.
entries.freshnessPolicy: Capture exact URL, retrieval timestamp, and geographic search level.
